subject: biology-2
question: During **neurulation**, the neural plate folds upward and fuses to form the **neural tube**. If the posterior end of this tube fails to close completely, which of the following conditions would most directly result?

options.text: A defect in the development of the spinal cord and the tissue around it.
A failure to form any germ layers.
The complete absence of muscle tissue.
The failure of the amnion to form around the embryo.

explanation: The neural tube develops into the brain and spinal cord, so incomplete closure of its posterior end disrupts spinal cord development. B is wrong because germ layers form earlier, during gastrulation. C is wrong because muscle arises from mesoderm, not the neural tube. D is wrong because the amnion is an extraembryonic membrane unrelated to the neural tube.
